app.name: Geezy
app.long_description: Wii VJ synth. Sideways remote, Classic Controller and class-compliant USB-MIDI Note buttons. APC mini/MK2 top row: worlds 0-4, theme/skin/reflection cycles; other rows: backgrounds, sculpture presets, motion/gears, 16 harmony banks, 8 momentary graphics, steer/charge/hit/remix/HUD. Scene notes 82-89: hold blackout, whiteout, freeze/stage, mirror, kaleidoscope, invert, mosaic, strobe. Classic ZR+A/B/X/Y/Up/Right/Down/Left; remote 1+2+A freeze, 1+2+B kaleidoscope. 14 sculpture families, indirect liquid chrome/grid pulses and hybrid worlds. Second remote enables upright dual-hand play: right A hit/cut, arrows scene/palette/motion/layout, B modifier master FX, +/- gear, 1 world, 2 theme. Twin shake remixes; held B enables wrist twist. MIDI CC ignored. Classic: stick steer, A charge, B graphics, X palette, Y scene, ZL theme, ZR harmony, Plus/Minus gear. Remote: A charge/strobe/release; B graphics; 1/2 palette/scene; arrows impulse/boost. 1+Plus HUD, 2+Plus theme, 1+Minus harmony bank. 2+Minus or Classic L+Y cycles worlds: orbit, horizon canyon, brutalist interior, point-cloud plexus, orthographic slicer. Four-color chrome, white/fog/halftone worlds, layered graphics and Z-buffer stencil windows. Plus+Minus reset; HOME exit. No sensor bar required.
